headline_hook: Mistral Drops a 128-Expert Beast While OpenAI Acquires the Python Toolchain

pick_of_the_day.thesis: OpenAI buying Astral isn't about ruff or uv — it's about owning the developer surface area. When your toolchain vendor is also your model vendor, the lock-in runs deeper than any API contract.

model_literacy.concept: Mixture of Experts (MoE) — active vs. total parameters
model_literacy.relevance: Mistral Small 4 has 119B total params but activates only a fraction per token via 128 experts. This is also why Qwen 3.5 397B runs on a Mac — MoE's sparse activation means 'model size' no longer equals 'memory required.' Understanding the distinction is key to evaluating any MoE benchmark claim.
